title: Detailed light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='42%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7b0'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ffd93b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9e00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bulbShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6c4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffc93c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='baseGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8ccd8'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#f2f4fa'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a9aeba'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='34' fill='#ffd93b' opacity='0.16'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='26' fill='#ffe98a' opacity='0.28'/>

  <!-- glass bulb -->
  <path d='M50 14 C34 14 24 26 24 39 C24 50 31 57 35 63 C37 66 38 69 38 72 L62 72 C62 69 63 66 65 63 C69 57 76 50 76 39 C76 26 66 14 50 14 Z'
        fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <path d='M37 24 C31 28 28 34 28 41' fill='none' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='24' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#fffef0' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(-25 40 24)'/>

  <!-- filament supports -->
  <path d='M44 72 L44 58' stroke='#e0a800' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 72 L56 58' stroke='#e0a800' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- filament coil -->
  <path d='M44 58 C44 50 48 46 50 46 C52 46 56 50 56 58' fill='none' stroke='#ff7b00' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 58 C46 53 48 50 50 50 C52 50 54 53 54 58' fill='none' stroke='#ffb300' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#fff2a8'/>

  <!-- screw base -->
  <rect x='38' y='72' width='24' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='url(#baseGrad)'/>
  <rect x='37' y='76' width='26' height='4' rx='2' fill='#9aa0ae'/>
  <rect x='38' y='80' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='url(#baseGrad)'/>
  <rect x='37' y='84' width='26' height='4' rx='2' fill='#9aa0ae'/>
  <rect x='38' y='88' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='url(#baseGrad)'/>

  <!-- contact tip -->
  <path d='M44 92 L56 92 L52 97 L48 97 Z' fill='#8a90a0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='95' r='1.8' fill='#c8ccd8'/>

  <!-- base shading lines -->
  <path d='M38 74 L62 74' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M37 82 L63 82' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.6' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
